verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a secrets scanner rather than a general SAST engine, but it does let you write your own rules: custom regex detectors, defined in a config.yaml passed via --config, with optional webhook verification (trufflehog-docs-6, trufflehog-docs-27, trufflehog-docs-14). Sharing is only indirect: a global core.hooksPath setup applies hooks to all repositories (trufflehog-docs-19), but no documented mechanism exists for distributing a rule set across repos. Missing for 10: rules beyond regex secret detection (general code-pattern static analysis), a documented way to share or centrally manage custom rules across repositories, independent or hands-on corroboration.
